description.value: Mr. Mike's is a Canadian casual steakhouse franchise with roots going back to 1960, serving premium steaks, burgers, pastas, salads, and shareable appetizers in a relaxed, unpretentious setting. The Fort St. John location sits on Alaska Road North along the Alaska Highway corridor, a natural waypoint for cyclists travelling through northeastern BC. The restaurant welcomes walk-ins and also offers takeout and delivery.
